page_title: STU 2-1 DOR | Stuttgart v Dortmund 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' A pass by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+3' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Maximilian Mittelstadt.
88' The substitution has been made. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) has replaced Enzo Millot.

87' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is free in the box and Maximilian Mittelstadt finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
86' Total attempts – 21:5.
83' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Gregor Kobel no chance!
83' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) brings his opponent down. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Stuttgart!!

79' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
79' Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

79' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Here is a change. Deniz Undav is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
77' The substitution is prepared. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Niclas Fullkrug.
76' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Stieler who sees an offensive foul.
75' A pass finds the feet of Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
74' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jamie Leweling leaves the pitch and Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
67' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Chris Fuhrich is replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
66' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul after dangerous play.
63' It is time for a substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) is on for Felix Nmecha.
63' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

62' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel punched it onto the post. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' A cross into the box from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
59' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
58' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner.

54' Close! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
51' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A yellow card for a tackle by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund). Tobias Stieler doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Edin Terzic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund). He is replaced by Marco Reus.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is replaced by Donyell Malen.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel reacts superbly to deny him.
45+3' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+3' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Jamie Leweling tees up Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Gregor Kobel.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Julian Ryerson puts the ball on a plate for Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.
34' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
34' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
31' A pass into the box finds Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gregor Kobel denies him.
28' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) is being substituted because of an injury. Edin Terzic sends Ramy Bensebaini on the pitch.
23' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
23' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Stuttgart for a penalty. Play continues.
15' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
15' Yellow card! It's like Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Tobias Stieler agrees and books him.
12' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart)! That was a huge opportunity! Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
11' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Gregor Kobel who easily stops the effort.
11' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
10' The foul by Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
10' A clumsy foul by Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
6' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Stieler saw the whole situation.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
